attributes.title: FMX 2027
attributes.summary:
FMX 2027, the American Academy of Family Physicians' main annual meeting, takes place Monday to Friday, September 20 to 24, 2027, at the San Diego Convention Center. AAFP describes more than 250 education sessions, an expo hall and more than 40 hours of continuing education credit on offer.

Registration is open. AAFP members pay $865 through May 31, 2027, and $1,015 from June 1 to July 26; non-members pay $1,175 or $1,365. Residents who are members pay $100 and student members $50. The exact credit designation for 2027 has not been published yet; cancellations are refunded less a $50 fee until August 30, 2027.
